subject: Executive arrival — host checkpoint & site entry tactical plan
content:
From: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, security@redwood.ai
Cc: Sarah Connors <sarah.connors@globex.com>
Date: Thu, 01 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Executive arrival — host checkpoint & site entry tactical plan

Team —

Below is the tactical plan for the executive-level workshop with Globex on Monday (4/5). This focuses solely on visitor access and host checkpoint tasks; ops/content logistics are tracked elsewhere. Please read and confirm assignments by EOD Friday.

High level
- Arrival window: 08:30–09:15 (three execs + two security liaisons).
- Primary entry: West Lobby visitor kiosk (Gate B). Secondary: Loading dock entrance (badging only for staff).
- Host checkpoint: Conference A reception desk will operate as the host checkpoint from 08:15–10:00.

Mandatory day-of controls- ID check + printed badge for every guest (photo optional)
- Prefix-only network access; no device onboarding without prior IT approval
- Visitor escorts assigned by name (matrix attached)

Assignments- Alex Martinez (me): point of contact for Globex execs; escalation owner for badge exceptions; will man the host checkpoint 08:15–09:45.
- Marissa Cole: lead host escort (exec-level routing, briefing room handoff).
- Ben Carter: host kiosk lead — responsible for kiosk operator, guest manifest ingestion, and badge printing.
- Kimberly Park: security liaison — will coordinate any redlines with building security and deliver site map for routes and secure zones.

Attachments (please review): guest_manifest_v2.xlsx (roster + dietary), site_map_entry_points.pdf (marked primary/secondary entry lanes), kiosk_instructions.txt (operator steps + printer troubleshooting).

Special notes / contingencies- If an unlisted guest arrives, do not admit without explicit confirmation from Alex or Kimberly; contact security@redwood.ai immediately.
- For parking passes or temporary badges for contractors, use the temporary badge pool — Ben will have the keycode.

If there are any changes to arrival times or names, reply-all immediately.

Thanks,
Alex Martinez
Head of Solutions — Redwood Inference
alex_martinez@redwood.ai

From: Sarah Connors <sarah.connors@globex.com>

Date: Thu, 01 Apr 2027 10:03:22 -0400
Subject: Re: Executive arrival — host checkpoint & site entry tactical plan

Alex —

Thanks for the plan, this looks good. A couple quick items from our side:
- We need a standard NDA signed at check-in for one guest (Mark D.). He'll arrive with the group but prefers to sign a paper copy.
- Two of our team members are carrying prototype hardware — will that trigger any additional onsite screening?

I can confirm final headcount by Friday 4/2 17:00 ET.

—Sarah

Quick operational update —
- Kiosk operator confirmed (Jamal Reyes) and will be onsite at 07:45 for warm-up and test print.
- Printer model: Zebra ZD621 (labels). Ben to carry spare labels and a USB-to-network adapter.
- I'll import guest_manifest_v2.xlsx into the kiosk system at 07:50 on Monday and pre-print badges for anyone listed as "confirmed".

Two asks for Alex / Kimberly:
1) Can we get a signed NDA template to have at the desk for Mark D.? (PDF for signature)
2) Kimberly, please confirm screening rules for prototype hardware — will building security need to be present?

Ben

Date: Fri, 02 Apr 2027 11:02:05 -0700

Ben / team —

Confirmed: building security will perform a visual inspection for prototype hardware only; anything that looks like a powered device will require a short device registration (serial + owner). I will be onsite to handle the registration and to escort out of secure zones if needed.

Attached updated guest_manifest_v2.xlsx (status column updated with "confirmed"/"pending") and a simplified arrival route map with a labeled VIP path to avoid public elevator banks (file: site_map_entry_points.pdf).

Also: Jamal (kiosk) should bring a handheld barcode scanner — we'll use temporary pass barcodes for contractor temp badges.

Kimberly Park
Security & Compliance Lead — Redwood Inference

Attachments: guest_manifest_v2.xlsx, site_map_entry_points.pdf
